name: Glute kickback (machine)
instructions: Set the foot pad so it meets your foot with the knee bent.
Hold the handles and rest your chest or forearms on the support pad.
Push the pad back with one leg until your hip is straight.
Return with control, then switch legs.
cue: Drive back through the heel, squeeze
mistakes: Arching the lower back to push further.
Swinging the leg instead of a steady push.
